faqs.q: Do you offer hosting and domains?
faqs.a: Yes — VELIX can handle hosting and domain setup end-to-end, or work with hosting the client already has. We recommend whichever option is fastest and most reliable for that specific site.

Every VELIX site ships with SEO fundamentals built in: clean structured markup, fast load times, meta tags, sitemaps, mobile optimization. Deeper ongoing SEO campaigns are available as an add-on for clients who want to actively grow search traffic over time.

Yes, standard on every build: HTTPS, hardened forms, regular dependency updates and monitoring. E-commerce or platforms handling sensitive data get extra layers: rate-limiting, authentication best practices, regular audits.

We choose the right stack per project rather than forcing one tool everywhere — typically modern HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript on the front end, and React, Node.js, or Shopify/WordPress on the back end depending on needs, with a strong focus on speed and security.

faqs.q: Can I see your previous work?
faqs.a: Yes — point them to the Portfolio page and offer to help identify which project is closest to what they have in mind.

VELIX Web Solutions is led by Moatasm Abdeen (Founder & CEO), who personally reviews every project before delivery, alongside a dedicated Backend Developer. The team is kept lean so every client gets real, senior attention.
